notes: The idle wave advances each tick, so --wave-amplitude 0 freezes the scene independently of auto-screenshot warmup. The shot order matches kShots[] in main_lua.cpp. References are macos-debug-only; other backends are out of scope until their sets are committed. The references were blessed after #5063 made sun-face record admission deterministic. A few texels along one screen line lose their sun-face record and read as shadowed. A later change to the sun-face record capacity or admission rule can move those texels; when it does, re-bless the references.
